standing_set: the live community
floor: more than 1/2 of those who voted, at least 2 voices
note: a holder of `moderate` acts alone in the window; on the moderators' absence a strict majority of the members who voted, never fewer than two voices

standing_set: the community's roster at the head the act names, less the act's author
note: the members' check: a strict majority of those seated at the head the act names, its author apart, lift a duty holder's single-signature act within the window; below that the act stands; a restored item returns consent-gated

standing_set: the community's roster, less the holder it recalls
note: the members recall any duty holder, however seated: more than two thirds of the standing roster cosign one row in the standing window; where that leaves no duty holder the room locks and elects

standing_set: the community's duty holders
floor: 2 voices, or the roster's size if smaller
note: a duty seat is conferred by a strict majority of all the duty holders of the room it is conferred in, with the new holder's acceptance; a lone duty holder confers alone

standing_set: the community's duty holders, less the holder concerned
note: a duty seat is withdrawn by a strict majority of the other duty holders, the holder concerned not counted; one other holder alone withdraws nothing, and the members' recall stays

standing_set: the accord holders
note: one holder fires at once; lapses at the fuse unless a majority confirms; a majority resumes

standing_set: the operator holding the record + the Wise Authority
note: the operator and the WA name the successor by one cosigned row; the old key's custody rows stay valid to that instant

standing_set: the deciding seat + one key outside it (the designated official, or a review-holder of the overseeing body)
note: a one-voice affiliation acts against a member only with an outside countersign; two or more seats decide under their own protocol

standing_set: the community's roster
enact: instant runoff over ranked choice of three
floor: 2 voices, or the roster's size if smaller
note: a locked room elects its moderator: ballot = the roster, its shown order deciding nothing, one ballot per person, a tie seats nobody and the count runs again, winner accepts or the next in runoff order

standing_set: the group's roster, counted as its declared protocol states
note: a cosigned row of a group lands when the signatures held meet the rule of the group's declared protocol; a shortfall is held for the hold window, which a group may set longer and never shorter, and then dropped

standing_set: the accord holders
note: a strict majority of the standing accord roster cosign one row: the confirmation and the resumption of a halt, and the standing acts; a roster change runs its own participation window (CC 4.2.6)

standing_set: the roster the poll's opening row names
floor: more than 1/2 of those who voted, at least 2 voices
note: a poll states its own rule in the row that opens it; where it states none, a strict majority of those who voted, never fewer than two voices, one ballot a person; the poll's own close ends it, so the row carries no window

standing_set: the designated body's full seated roster, counted as its declared protocol states
note: a finding of the designated Wise Authority body is one row cosigned under the body's own declared protocol, as any cosigned act of a group; the denominator is the full seated roster, never the live subset
